thought.text: Now let me create a test user with the required roles and verify authentication works end-to-end.

reasoning_content:
Now let me create a test user with the roles. Let me also verify the OIDC discovery endpoint works and that a token can be obtained. Then verify the frontend serves and the whole system.

Let me create a test user.

action.command:
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh create users -r my-realm -s username=testuser -s enabled=true -s email=test@example.com -s firstName=Test -s lastName=User 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "U:$?"
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh set-password -r my-realm --username testuser --new-password 'Test1234!' 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "P:$?"
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh add-roles -r my-realm --uusername testuser --rolename app-access --rolename editor 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "ROLE:$?"
